$comment: Third-party MIT projects built on Remotion, the M4 proof. Each is fetched at the pinned commit into .cache/<name> by projects.ts (never vendored). entries: id to the bundle entry (a file that calls registerRoot) and the project script that bundles it, which the oracle mirrors: tailwind is set when that script wraps its webpack config in enableTailwind(), ignoreRegisterRootWarning when it passes that option to bundle() (Remotion looks for the text registerRoot in the entry file; Motio does not need it). Every composition of every entry is compared on the frames sampleFrames() picks. excluded: registerRoot files that are not measured, with the reason. Both renderers use gl swangle (software WebGL, Motio's default): GPU WebGL differs per machine (D-046). skip: compositions of an entry left out of the comparison, with the reason (external or random content, files the repository does not contain). knownMismatch: compositions whose stills are expected to miss the thresholds, with the cause; the test fails once they match, so the marker has to be removed then. knownFlickerMismatch: compositions whose stills match but whose frames around flagged flicker are drawn unlike Remotion for a known cause; those frames are not held to Remotion's.

skip.github-stars: the repository avatar comes from unavatar.io, an external service that rate-limits repeated renders (HTTP 429), and the component then draws the owner's initial instead: the content depends on the service, not on the renderer

skip.backdrop-image: its backdrop is https://picsum.photos/1280/720, a different random photo on every request
